notes.title: NEDRA – Update v1.0.5
notes.content:
This update focuses on improving gameplay balance, fixing bugs, and addressing community feedback. As a solo developer, I truly appreciate all the support and detailed reports you've shared.

What's new in v1.0.5:

Minor bug fixes and stability improvements

Adjusted combat for better balance

Increased time before hypothermia begins

Fixed several audio issues

Fixed collision issues in various areas

Reduced intensity of the alcohol screen effect

Enlarged the warning text in the main menu about potentially uncomfortable visual/audio elements

Other small fixes and improvements

Thanks again to everyone who’s played and provided feedback. I’ll continue working to improve the game with future updates.

tags.bug: Fixed collision issues in various areas

tags.balance_change: Reduced intensity of the alcohol screen effect

tags.feature: Enlarged the warning text in the main menu about potentially uncomfortable visual/audio elements

notes.title: NEDRA is officially out now on Steam!
notes.content:
[h3]The wait is over — [i]NEDRA[/i] is officially out now on Steam! ❄️[/h3][h3]Enter the frozen ruins of an abandoned Soviet station, uncover ancient horrors beneath the ice, and try to survive the unforgiving cold… if you can.

🎥 Don’t miss the brand new intense trailer — a deeper look into the terror that awaits beneath the ice.

[/h3][previewyoutube="V7w7FSo-rIA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]🧊 Atmospheric survival horror set in the polar night
🌡️ Unique stealth system based on body temperature
👁️ A slow-burning, Lovecraftian story full of dread and discovery
🔧 Includes Day One improvements and fixes based on demo feedback

[/p][h3]Play now and tell us what you think! 

[b]P.S. If you find an issue, feel free to message me — I’ll be happy to help![/b][/h3][p]

Davit
Creator of NEDRA[/p]
